name: @lpdfio/lpdf
description: Lpdf JavaScript SDK: render PDF documents from XML or from code. With data binding, PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X and Factur-X / ZUGFeRD.

scripts.build:browser: tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser-worker.json && node build-browser.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p test/types && node --test test/render.test.mjs test/cross-industry-invoice.test.mjs test/package-entry.test.mjs test/browser-types.test.mjs test/timeout.test.mjs test/memory.test.mjs test/stamp.test.mjs test/merge.test.mjs test/third-party-licenses.test.mjs

author: lpdf.io
